choices.content: Start at any arbitrarily chosen value, as long as it looks good
Have scale intervals that vary in size to emphasize key points
Start at 0 and have evenly spaced scale intervals

question.prompt: To prevent a bar chart from being misleading, its vertical axis should generally

solutions.explanation: When the vertical axis starts at 0 and has evenly spaced scale intervals, the bar heights are proportional to the values, so differences are neither exaggerated nor diminished.
solutions.title: Preserve proportional bar heights
